name: reachinbox-email-scheduler
description: Production-ready Email Job Scheduler and Dashboard — ReachInbox hiring assignment

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @reachinbox/shared && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @reachinbox/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @reachinbox/api" "npm run dev -w @reachinbox/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @reachinbox/shared && npm run dev -w @reachinbox/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build -w @reachinbox/shared && npm run dev:worker -w @reachinbox/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @reachinbox/shared && npm run build -w @reachinbox/api && npm run build -w @reachinbox/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @reachinbox/api && npm run lint -w @reachinbox/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @reachinbox/shared && npm run typecheck -w @reachinbox/api && npm run typecheck -w @reachinbox/web
